description: Source file implementing profiling classes and functions for Torch JIT runtime, including ScriptProfile and ProfilesRegistry, with bindings for SourceRef, InstructionStats, and SourceStats.

classes.name: ProfilesRegistry
classes.description: Manages active profiling instances, thread-safe, with methods to add, remove, and check if empty.

classes.name: ScriptProfile
classes.description: Represents a profiling session, with methods to enable, disable, add datapoints, and dump statistics.

classes.name: InstructionSpan
classes.description: Tracks a span of instruction execution, sending datapoints upon destruction.

methods.name: ProfilesRegistry::empty
methods.description: Checks if the registry has no active profiles.

methods.name: ProfilesRegistry::addProfile
methods.description: Adds a ScriptProfile to the registry.

methods.name: ProfilesRegistry::removeProfile
methods.description: Removes a ScriptProfile from the registry.

methods.name: ProfilesRegistry::send
methods.description: Sends a datapoint to all active profiles.

methods.name: getProfilesRegistry
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProfilesRegistry.

methods.name: initBindings
methods.description: Initializes Python bindings for profiling classes.

methods.name: InstructionSpan::InstructionSpan
methods.description: Constructor that starts a datapoint for a node.

methods.name: InstructionSpan::~InstructionSpan
methods.description: Destructor that ends the datapoint and sends it.

methods.name: isProfilingOngoing
methods.description: Checks if profiling is currently active.

methods.name: ScriptProfile::addDatapoint
methods.description: Adds a datapoint to the profile.
